mode.title: Mode
mode.description: arb = fee-adjusted funding-arbitrage opportunities; rates = raw funding rate per venue per coin.

symbols.title: Coins (optional filter)
symbols.description: Filter to these coin symbols, e.g. ["BTC", "ETH"]. Empty = all coins.

venues.title: Exchanges (optional filter)
venues.description: Filter to these venues, e.g. ["hyperliquid", "paradex"]. Empty = all 8 venues.

minNetApr.title: Minimum net APR (arb mode)
minNetApr.description: Only return arb opportunities with net APR at or above this (decimal, e.g. 0.10 = 10%).

requireOi.title: Require verified open interest (arb mode)
requireOi.description: Drop opportunities where a leg's open interest is unknown (recommended - filters thin/stale markets).
